title: Hemodynamic Homeostasis: Arterial Pressure, Volume, and Hypertension as Setpoint Reset
abstract: MAP is owned by no single organ; the CO x SVR x volume loop is closed from the per-system seams and read through the PIEZO1/2 and NKCC2 sensors. Fast baroreflex and slow pressure-natriuresis defense are reproduced; essential hypertension is a setpoint reset and chronic heart failure a saddle-node basin collapse.
headline_results: MAP = CVP + CO x SVR = 93 mmHg

chapters.title: Mean arterial pressure is owned by no single organ
chapters.one_liner: Mean arterial pressure obeys MAP = CVP + CO×SVR, closing across the cardiac and vascular seams to a resting 93 mmHg; no single organ owns it. Relation [V], scale [O].

chapters.title: Node identities grounded in real DNA: master-gene γ from nearest-neighbour thermodynamics
chapters.one_liner: Node identities come from master-gene stacking γ measured from real human promoters (SantaLucia 1998): SIX2 reproduces the DNA atlas, REN γ=1.3634, never fitted [V].

chapters.title: Sensory transduction: PIEZO1/2 baroreceptor and NKCC2 macula densa
chapters.one_liner: Two molecular transducers read the loop variables: PIEZO1/2 (arterial stretch) and NKCC2 (luminal NaCl); renin falls and TGF rises with NaCl. Identity [L].

chapters.title: The baroreflex fast buffer and PIEZO knockout
chapters.one_liner: The baroreflex buffers ~75% of a 20 mmHg step (residual = step/(1+G), G = 3); PIEZO knockout removes transduction and pressure is labile. Buffering shape [V], gain [L].

chapters.title: Pressure-natriuresis as an integral controller (Guyton)
chapters.one_liner: Renal pressure-natriuresis is integral control dV/dt = intake − k(P−P_set); two transient loads return to the same 93 mmHg (spread 0, Guyton infinite gain). Shape [V].

chapters.title: Essential hypertension as a setpoint reset
chapters.one_liner: Essential hypertension is an integral-controller setpoint reset: the defended attractor shifts up by ΔP_set (+20 mmHg); operating-point drugs are opposed back. Shape [V].

chapters.title: Chronic heart failure as a saddle-node basin collapse
chapters.one_liner: Chronic heart failure is a saddle-node basin collapse: the high-output basin annihilates at spinodal(κ*) = |load|; closed-form κ* = 1.629 matches the sweep. Shape [V].

chapters.title: The hemodynamic interaction map (sensor to MAP to feedback)
chapters.one_liner: The hemodynamic map: 7 nodes, 11 edges link the PIEZO/NKCC2 sensors through fast baroreflex and slow RAAS/kidney loops to MAP and back. Edges [L], loop shapes [V].

chapters.title: Fundamental vs symptomatic treatment of hypertension and heart failure
chapters.one_liner: Loop structure splits fundamental from symptomatic therapy: hypertension tracks a renal reset (−17 vs 0 mmHg); HF mortality tracks margin M = spinodal(κ)−|load|. [V].

chapters.title: Hypotension as a node decomposition of the pressure loop
chapters.one_liner: Hypotension is not one disease but a node decomposition of the pressure loop: orthostatic, adrenal, distributive, hypovolemic, cardiogenic — distinct node failures. [V]

chapters.title: Universality: defended pressure as an emergent property of loop accretion
chapters.one_liner: A defended pressure setpoint is emergent: open systems have incidental pressure, a fast reflex leaves error, only circuit + effector + integrator defend it. [V]

chapters.title: Absolute-scale calibration: anchoring the model to clinical units without deriving it
chapters.one_liner: Absolute mmHg, Hz, gain, NaCl/GFR, reset and effect-size scales are anchored to cited clinical values and cross-checked; first-principles derivation stays open. [CAL]

chapters.title: The comfort principle: counter-regulation is the structural origin of the side-effect class
chapters.one_liner: An operating-point antihypertensive is opposed back to the reference by the kidney integrator; that rejection is the structural origin of the side-effect class [V].

chapters.title: Lever H1: reset the integrator reference down (the counter-regulation-free direction)
chapters.one_liner: Lever H1 lowers the renal pressure-natriuresis / RAAS reference itself, so the loop target moves with it; two H1 axes are DNA-grounded (REN, SIX2) [V].

chapters.title: Lever H2: restore the fast restoring buffer (raise the loop’s own correcting current)
chapters.one_liner: Lever H2 strengthens the baroreflex buffer (PIEZO1/2 stretch transduction) so excursions self-correct toward the lower setpoint; counter-regulation stays low [V].

chapters.title: Lever H3: unload the effector — paired-only, because alone it is the side-effect class
chapters.one_liner: Lever H3 unloads the effector; alone it is the operating-point push the loop opposes back (RP4) — the side-effect class — so it is a paired-only lever [V].

chapters.title: Comfort proposal: seven structural hypotheses, stated as directions, not treatments
chapters.one_liner: Seven hypotheses (HP1-HP7) stated as structural directions read off the proven loop, never as treatments: setpoint, perfusion floor, axis ranking, pairing rule [F].

chapters.title: Comfort prioritisation: rank target axes by declared weights, never agents
chapters.one_liner: Target axes are ranked by declared weights (burden, unmet, counter-regulation-freedom, grounding); reference-reset axes lead and γ is carried, never scored [F].

chapters.title: Comfort falsification: every hypothesis is refutable, including the framework
chapters.one_liner: Every comfort hypothesis carries a named falsifier, and so does the framework itself; HP1, HP6 and the framework-level refutation conditions are stated explicitly [V].

chapters.title: Comfort firewall: a structural prediction, with no medical responsibility
chapters.one_liner: The firewall is fail-closed: the package states a structural prediction about loop counter-regulation but asserts no molecule, regimen, or safety result [O].
